EC1: Patients who are recipients of multiple solid organ [OR] or islet cell tissue transplants [OR], or have previously received an organ [OR] or tissue transplant [OR]. Patients who have a combined liver-kidney transplant.
EC2: History of malignancy of any organ system ([NOT] other than localized basal cell carcinoma of the skin), treated [OR] or untreated, within the past 5 years, regardless of whether there is evidence of local recurrence or metastases.
EC3: Existence of any surgical [OR], medical [OR] or mental conditions [AND], [NOT] other than the current transplantation, which, in the opinion of the investigator, might interfere with the objectives of the study.
